title: From Toronto: AYCE Maple Syrup Tour + St Jacobs Farmers Market
includes: Free time at St Jacobs farmers market
Taste Golden, Amber & Dark Maple syrup
Guided tour of a Sugar Bush with the farmers themselves
Taste of Maple Taffy, raw sap, partially cooked sap, fresh maple sugar and fresh maple toffee
Entrance to the Maple Syrup Museum of Ontario
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Explore the charm of rural Canada on this delightful tour featuring a visit to a Maple Sugar Bush for an insightful tour and tasting. Learn about maple syrup production while sampling various grades of syrup and indulging in maple taffy. You'll get an All you can Eat breakfast including pancakes, sausages, bacon, syrup, drinks, and more! Finally, experience the vibrant St. Jacobs Farmers Market, the largest in Canada, showcasing local Mennonite produce and delicious food options. This tour is conducted in a comfortable 14-passenger transit with entertainment options, making it a perfect day out for families and food lovers alike.

- Visit a Maple Sugar Bush for a guided tour and syrup tasting with breakfast included
- Discover the largest indoor/outdoor market in Canada at St. Jacobs
- Enjoy a comfortable ride in a 15-passenger transit with onboard entertainment
